statements.impact_statement: linux-libc-dev is present only in the disposable Dapper builder as user-space API headers required by libc6-dev for GCC and Go race tests. The builder contains no Linux kernel image or module package and is never shipped or run as the product. The independently scanned container-cron binary and runtime image report zero Critical or High findings.
